Motion-Primitives - UI kit to make beautiful, animated interfaces, faster.

name: Motion-Primitives
summary: Open-source React UI kit of 23 copy-paste animated components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS.
description: Reusable animated components for React and Next.js: text effects (loop, morph, roll, scramble, shimmer), animated backgrounds, infinite slider, carousel, dock, cursor, dialog, accordion, disclosure, in-view animations, transition panel, number animations, glow effect and image comparison. Each component has docs with examples and a component API; add it with a CLI command or copy the code manually. Open source under the MIT license, currently in beta.
contains: 23 animated components, open source, in beta
text effects: text effect, loop, morph, roll, scramble, shimmer, shimmer wave
UI components: accordion, disclosure, carousel, cursor, dialog, dock, transition panel, image comparison
effects: animated background, animated group, border trail, in view, infinite slider, glow
docs give examples and a component API for each component
install with a CLI command or copy the code manually
built with Motion and Tailwind CSS, icons via Lucide
